text: QuikTrip Corporation is a privately held convenience store and gasoline service station chain headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, majority-owned by the Cadieux family.

source.name: Forbes: QuikTrip | Company Overview & News
source.quote: The company remains majority-owned by the Cadieux family, with about 20% of ownership held through an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), reflecting its commitment to employee investment and long-term growth.
